digest.component_or_area: package build config + metrics analyzer optional extra
propositions: Package the metrics analyzer and its lizard dependency behind an optional [metrics] extra, registering it in _optional.EXTRAS so guard_import(extra='metrics') is available
Lazily import lizard inside analyzer.py only when explicitly needed, never at package initialization, so core-only install remains dependency-free
guard_import raises OptionalDependencyError when the metrics extra is not installed; adapters catch this and degrade code_health to Unavailable with the extra name in the reason
Core-only install (without [metrics] extra) must allow 'rebar metrics' to run without crashing and report code_health as Unavailable
scc and jscpd remain external CLIs detected at runtime, not pip dependencies, and are documented in pyproject.toml comments
